description: Ownership reference set: 19 documents (the same documents as the other reference sets). Items are material owned by non-Contributors, taken from each document's entry.json as it stands. The check weights a whole figure, word-for-word passage, close paraphrase or reworded idea from an identifiable work 1.0 and an adapted figure or item of unconfirmed origin 0.5, and gives a complete credit (title, author, source, licence, date) 1.0, complete but for the date 0.75, partial 0.5, none or wrong source 0; some records weight close paraphrase 0.5, leave out reworded ideas and count a credit complete without its date, so z against this set is approximate. Clip art and icons, contributing Members' own material, and ideas common across a field are excluded. Ownership score = total weight per 1,000 words; poorly cited ownership score = total weight x (1 - cited) per 1,000 words.

class_rule.note: Poorly cited ownership is classed by a fixed rule, not by the mean and standard deviation of the reference set: good = a score up to 0.05 per 1,000 words, as long as no whole figure or word-for-word passage (weight 1.0) has no credit at all; bad = above 0.15 per 1,000 words (roughly one word-for-word passage with no credit per 6,700 words); improving = in between. Good isn't limited to a score of exactly 0, because a long document almost never scores exactly 0.
